description: Mega Ultra League team submitted by community member Jeff Frost and showcased by the creator: Volt Switch non-Shadow Forretress lead, Feraligatr as the safe/sage switch, and Mega Altaria as the closer. Mega Altaria's Dragon/Fairy typing walls Electric threats and core-breaks teams expecting a Flying-type Altaria.
performanceNotes: Mega Altaria's Dragon/Fairy typing resists Volt Switch and neutralizes Fortress mirrors, walling Mega Raichu X completely
Feraligatr snowballs with banked Hydro Cannon energy to sweep late game
Team struggles against Seismitoad (Icy Wind pressures Altaria)

sources.author: HomeSliceHenry
sources.videoTitle: MEGA Ultra League at 3100 ELO looks INCREDIBLE...
